articles.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.snippet: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
articles.snippet: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

articles.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
articles.snippet: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.
